title: A spanning set contains the columns of a unit matrix
statement: For any field F, natural number n, and set s ⊆ F^n whose F-linear span is F^n, there exists t in GL_n(F) such that every column of t belongs to s.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Submodule.exists_fun_fin_finrank_span_eq to extract a linearly independent spanning family from s. Its index has size n because the span is top and finrank F (Fin n → F) = n. Form its basis B. Relative to the standard basis E, E.toMatrix B and B.toMatrix E are mutually inverse by Module.Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip. Their unit matrix has precisely the vectors of B as columns, hence columns in s.

theorem exists_unit_matrix_columns_mem (F : Type u) [Field F] (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set (Fin n → F)) (hs : Submodule.span F s = ⊤) :
    ∃ t : GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) F, ∀ j, (fun i ↦ t.val i j) ∈ s
